explanation: Backtrack through empty Sudoku cells and try every value compatible with the row, column and square region. Restore a cell to empty after all choices fail.
timeComplexity: O(n²·n^(e+1)) conservative bound for an n×n board and e empty cells
spaceComplexity: O(n²) recursion depth; the board is filled in place
